# ubiops_organization (Resource)

Manages a UbiOps organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ubiops_organization" "example" {
  name                             = "my-organization"
  subscription                     = "professional"
  two_factor_authentication_forced = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the organization

### Optional

- `subscription` (String) Name of the subscription for the organization
- `subscription_end_date` (String) End date of the subscription. The subscription will be cancelled on this date.
- `subscription_start_date` (String) Start date of the new subscription. The required format is `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- `two_factor_authentication_forced` (Boolean) Whether 2FA is enforced on the organization users

### Read-Only

- `creation_date` (String) Date and time the organization was created
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the organization (UUID)
- `status` (String) Status of the organization

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ubiops_organization.example my-organization
```
